The candidate declares all three platforms mandatory, but only Windows and macOS artifacts are present. Required platform coverage and aggregate certification inputs are incomplete.

The bundles explicitly state that manual interactive acceptance remains required and formal P1A/P2 completion, production eligibility, and release certification are false. No completed Windows/macOS/Linux behavioral receipt matrix was found.

The reviewed candidate predates the canonical Test Center contract and does not yet provide P1/P1A/P2 stable test IDs, Project Test Profile entries, affected-test mappings, or normalized adapters required for shared architecture integration.

Windows and macOS artifact integrity is internally consistent: outer Actions digests match, nested sidecars match result metadata, exact source commit/tree bindings match the candidate, and 369 Windows plus 386 macOS manifest entries verified without hash failures.
